paragraphs.content: Let me start by saying that I know this is a lot, but idk I enjoyed every second of it in a purely personal capacity as much as the social one between us, which I suppose occurs once you look at this. Nevertheless, the act of making this, laborious as it was, it was an act in practicing my love for you, and there is hardly anything else i would rather spend my life doing than that. I love you, and that is a fact, unchanged and unchanging.
